detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This report does not describe any malicious code or behavior. It documents an automated process for upgrading dependencies to remediate known vulnerabilities, not malware. Detection should focus on identifying vulnerable versions of dependencies (e.g., com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.9.9.3) and ensuring they are updated to secure versions as recommended by security tools.
